findings.issue: כִּי is only tagged as a conjunction; «cuando» locks a temporal sense and closes if/that.
The suffix is 2mp (the addressees’ generations); «sus» can be read as the generations of «el que».
אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ is one construct (a fire-offering of an odor); the comma can be read as a second object of «hiciere».
H5207 is the soothing/quieting of the odor; «reposo» names rest.
Qal jussive is smoothed to future indicative, so the jussive force is no longer marked.

notes: 2mp is ustedes/harán; יהוה is Jehová; גור and גר both remain.
